name: Black Ice

evidence.note: Band site lists Oct 3 at Trotters, Franklin Square, 9 PM-12 AM, dinner reservations suggested; says it plays high-energy shows to packed bars.
Typical gig: two sets of classic hard rock hits at a pub with food and drink.

dancing.notes: A hard rock cover band at bar-restaurants where people book dinner tables. Some fans may dance to the hits, but we found no clear sign of a dance floor.

description: A Queens-based cover band that plays big classic rock and hard rock hits at bars and restaurants in Queens and on Long Island.
genres: classic rock and hard rock covers
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Many acts are named Black Ice (e.g., an Oakland deathrock band on Bandsintown). This NYC/LI cover band is confirmed by its own listing of the Oct 3 Trotters show.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current links all confirmed from the band's own site. Booking email is published by the band for bookings (TMC management); the phone numbers on the site belong to the venues, so none recorded. Upcoming Long Island show not in our data: Farrell's of Brooklyn, West Islip, Sat Oct 17, 2026, 8 PM (band site + flyer); the Oct 31 Bantry Bay Halloween show is in Long Island City, Queens (not Long Island). Logo is the band's tall logo artwork used as the site's share image. Skipped flyers and crowd shots showing fans. No separate booking page; the home page carries the booking note.

logo.alt: Black Ice logo: a crowned skull over a glowing blue globe above the words BLACK ICE and BlackIceRocks.com, on black
